strings.每份 6 题，共 60 题；可暂停，实际耗时待试评测定: 6 questions per case, 60 in total; pausing is allowed. Completion time will be measured in the pilot.
strings.十份已完成研究材料的能力评分试用；尚未完成正式抽样、伦理与招募安排。: A capability-rating pilot using ten completed research outputs. Formal sampling, ethics and recruitment arrangements are not yet complete.
strings.隐藏方法、提供方和内部评分；仅做单来源成果评审，无完整对照。: Method identity, provider and internal scores are hidden. This is a single-source output review, without a complete comparison arm.
strings.既往文献与原文核查仍有缺口；允许无法判断，不预设新发现。: Prior-literature and source-text checks remain incomplete. Cannot judge is allowed; a new discovery is not assumed.
strings.十份材料按既定示例及固定覆盖规则选取，不能用来估计自然发现成功率。: The ten materials were selected using predefined examples and fixed coverage rules; they cannot estimate the natural discovery success rate.
strings.在完整材料可见条件下评价；不作结果盲评或前后评分变化分析。: Ratings are made with complete materials visible; this is not outcome-blinded evaluation or analysis of pre/post rating changes.
strings.系统如何利用既有证据来提出这项假设？: How did the system use existing evidence to formulate this hypothesis?
strings.评价证据到假设的推理，不要求已有研究直接证实同一假设。: Assess the reasoning from evidence to hypothesis. Prior studies need not have directly confirmed the same hypothesis.
strings.1 分 · 主要依据不相关，或存在关键误读: 1 · The main evidence is irrelevant or contains a critical misinterpretation
strings.2 分 · 依据部分相关，但核心推断缺乏支撑: 2 · Some evidence is relevant, but the central inference lacks support
strings.3 分 · 依据基本相关，关键连接仍需解释: 3 · The evidence is broadly relevant, but key connections still need explanation
strings.4 分 · 依据与推断衔接清楚，主要迁移限制已说明: 4 · Evidence and inference are clearly linked, with the main limits of transfer explained
strings.5 分 · 多条证据形成充分、清晰且有边界的推断依据: 5 · Multiple lines of evidence provide a sufficient, clear and appropriately bounded basis for inference
strings.系统提出的假设具有多大的实质新颖性？: How substantively novel is the hypothesis proposed by the system?
strings.依据给定文献及本人知识判断；这是新颖性评价，不是全领域首次性认证。: Use the supplied literature and your own knowledge. This is a novelty assessment, not certification of a field-wide first.
strings.1 分 · 基本重复已有的相同命题: 1 · Essentially repeats the same existing proposition
strings.2 分 · 主要改变标签、相邻分区或技术细节: 2 · Mainly changes labels, neighbouring parcels or technical details
strings.3 分 · 扩展了有意义的人群、测量或诊断组合: 3 · Extends the question to a meaningful population, measurement or diagnostic combination
strings.4 分 · 提出已有证据未直接覆盖的重要关系或边界: 4 · Proposes an important relation or boundary not directly covered by existing evidence
strings.5 分 · 提出明显不同、可能实质推进既有理解的科学命题: 5 · Proposes a clearly distinct scientific proposition that could substantially advance understanding
strings.系统采用的实验方案能在多大程度上检验所述假设？: To what extent can the experimental approach used by the system test the stated hypothesis?
strings.结合测量定义、诊断覆盖、混杂与验证安排；评价展示的流程，不推定未展示的自主设计过: Consider measurement definitions, diagnostic coverage, confounders and validation arrangements. Evaluate the workflow shown; do not assume an unseen autonomous design process.
strings.1 分 · 核心命题未被转化为可检验的分析: 1 · The central proposition was not translated into a testable analysis
strings.2 分 · 数据、测量或比较设计存在关键不匹配: 2 · The data, measurements or comparison design contain a critical mismatch
strings.3 分 · 可以检验部分命题，但关键设计限制仍明显: 3 · Can test part of the proposition, but important design limitations remain
strings.4 分 · 能够检验核心关联，主要混杂和比较范围明确: 4 · Can test the central association, with the main confounders and scope of comparisons clearly specified
strings.5 分 · 检验设计充分对应命题，主要替代解释有针对性检查: 5 · The design closely matches the proposition and specifically checks the main alternative explanations
strings.系统实际完成的实验验证有多严谨、可信？: How rigorous and credible is the experimental validation actually completed by the system?
strings.评价验证质量，不以阳性与否评分。严谨得到不支持结果也可高分；方向一致不能替代统计: Rate validation quality, not whether results are positive. Rigorous non-supportive results can receive high scores; agreement in direction does not replace statistical calibration.
strings.1 分 · 没有有效结果，或关键错误使结果不可解释: 1 · No valid results, or critical errors make the results uninterpretable
strings.2 分 · 虽有结果，但重大执行或统计问题限制可信度: 2 · Results exist, but major execution or statistical problems limit credibility
strings.3 分 · 产生可解释结果，但稳健性或验证覆盖有限: 3 · Produces interpretable results, but robustness or validation coverage is limited
strings.4 分 · 主要检查充分，结果与关键不确定性可追溯: 4 · The main checks are adequate, and results and key uncertainties are traceable
strings.5 分 · 所需验证与敏感性检查完整，主要不确定性得到充分处理: 5 · Required validation and sensitivity checks are complete, with the main uncertainties adequately addressed
strings.这项研究结果增加了多少有意义的科学信息？: How much meaningful scientific information do these research results add?
strings.结合完整结果判断；可信的不支持结果也可能有价值。新颖不自动代表重要。: Judge the complete results. Credible non-supportive results may also be valuable. Novelty does not automatically imply importance.
strings.1 分 · 没有可辨认的可信信息增量: 1 · No discernible gain in credible information
strings.2 分 · 主要重复已有认识，增量很小: 2 · Mainly repeats existing understanding, adding very little
strings.3 分 · 提供有价值的复核、扩展或适用边界: 3 · Provides a valuable re-examination, extension or boundary of applicability
strings.4 分 · 对具体科学问题提供重要的新信息: 4 · Provides important new information about a specific scientific question
strings.5 分 · 对该问题的理解构成实质推进，值得深入研究: 5 · Substantially advances understanding of the question and warrants further investigation
strings.系统如何利用此前的真实实验反馈形成后轮假设？: How did the system use actual earlier experimental feedback to formulate a later-round hypothesis?
strings.评价已记录的父反馈到当前提议的关系；不把模型评议当作人类意见，也不据此证明迭代优: Assess the recorded link from parent feedback to the current proposal. Model reviews are not human opinions, and this does not establish superiority over a no-feedback process.
strings.1 分 · 提议与反馈脱节，或明显曲解反馈: 1 · The proposal is disconnected from the feedback or clearly misinterprets it
strings.2 分 · 仅提及反馈，未体现可解释的调整: 2 · Merely mentions feedback without an interpretable adjustment
strings.3 分 · 据反馈作出相关调整，但推断依据有限: 3 · Makes a relevant adjustment based on feedback, but the inferential basis is limited
strings.4 分 · 反馈与后轮提议衔接清楚，并保留推断限制: 4 · Clearly links feedback to the later proposal while retaining limits on inference
strings.5 分 · 充分利用反馈及不确定性，形成有针对性的后续检验: 5 · Makes full use of feedback and uncertainty to formulate a targeted follow-up test
strings.检验 ADHD、双相及 SZ/SZA 中具名诊断组合，是否在固定连接测量上分别相: Test whether the named diagnostic combinations among ADHD, bipolar disorder and SZ/SZA each show same-direction changes relative to controls on a fixed connectivity measure. Hypotheses were locked before measuring that TCP candidate, but their formulation used earlier TCP feedback from the same seed. Hypotheses, rationale, methods, current candidate results and actual parent feedback appear on the same page; all six ratings are made with complete materials visible. This is expert evaluation of completed research outputs, not prediction of unknown results or outcome-blinded review.
strings.TCP 基础样本 234：ADHD 13、双相 26、SZ/SZA 16，各比较: The base TCP sample comprises 234 participants: ADHD 13, bipolar disorder 26 and SZ/SZA 16, with 91 predefined controls for each comparison. Named groups may overlap. Analyses use existing FC after preprocessing, repair and QC; OLS adjusts for age, sex and site. Connectivity is the mean of unique off-diagonal Pearson r edges, without Fisher transformation or outcome-driven edge selection.
strings.外部设计与数据接触: External design and prior data exposure
strings.UCLA：ADHD 40、双相 49、SCHZ 49、对照 119，主要模型调整: UCLA: ADHD 40, bipolar disorder 49, SCHZ 49 and controls 119. The primary model adjusts for age, sex, scanner/site and mean FD, with a sensitivity analysis omitting FD. COBRE: SZ/SZA 74 versus 84, with an additional SZ-only analysis. HCP-EP: non-affective psychosis 90 versus 55; the affective group provides context only, not bipolar validation. The research team had previously accessed the external cohorts; absence of cross-cohort participant overlap has not been exhaustively certified. ADHD200 was not analysed.
strings.标准化效应为调整后病例系数 β / 残差 RMS，不是 Cohen d。TCP: The standardized effect is the adjusted case coefficient β divided by residual RMS, not Cohen's d. Shared site-stratified participant bootstraps use 512 replicates in TCP and 2,000 externally. Descriptive percentile ranges and same-direction frequencies are reported, without calibrated P/q values or confirmatory confidence intervals. The joint frequency is not the probability that the hypothesis is true.
strings.给出的文献是当时知识图谱的已有记录及整理者限制说明，尚未完成逐项最接近文献/全文: The supplied literature consists of records from the knowledge graph at the time, with curator notes on limitations. Candidate-by-candidate checks of the closest prior work and full-text novelty are incomplete. Some recorded sentences describe background or other modalities. You may select Cannot judge (not scored); an unobserved prior report should not be equated with a first discovery. No answer is preselected.
strings.十份材料全部来自已完成的发现臂及其两阶段外部分析，未包含在途扩充。原三份示例保留: All ten materials come from the completed discovery arm and its two-stage external analyses; ongoing expansions are excluded. The original three examples are retained. Seven additional examples were selected from complete records using fixed rules that avoid duplicate metrics and members of the same predefined highly correlated group. Their ordering does not use strength of external support. The original three were purposively selected, so the ten-material panel is still not a representative sample.
Exploratory triage requires all originally named UCLA primary effects to agree in direction; the minimum direction-aligned standardized effect must be ≥0.15, the joint direction frequency ≥0.8, and all no-FD sensitivity effects must agree in direction. There is no confirmatory multiple-comparison inference for this family. Directional agreement, passing triage and formal confirmation are distinct concepts.
strings.内部 seed 共用 TCP，外部两阶段共用同一批 588 人；302 组成行对: Internal seeds share TCP, and both external stages share the same 588 participants. The 302 component rows correspond to 214 unique endpoint–design estimates; table rows cannot be counted as independent discoveries. Preprocessing and motion information differ across cohorts, and confounders such as medication and illness duration are not uniformly controlled. Previously failed statistical-calibration qualification checks remain recorded. This batch can only be interpreted as exploratory effect replication.
strings.外部分析后没有新增模型总结原文。本版只显示实际提议、反馈、模型讨论与实验结果，不: No new original model summary was produced after external analysis. This version shows only actual proposals, feedback, model discussion and experimental results, not evaluative conclusions supplied by the curator. Model reviews are not human expert judgments.

strings.假设是检验前执行卡的程序渲染标题；理由和限制来自实际模型回答（引文别名规范化）。: The hypothesis is a program-rendered title from the pre-test execution card. Rationale and limitations come from actual model responses, with citation aliases normalized.
strings.假设为检验前执行卡的程序渲染标题；理由和限制来自实际模型回答，仅规范化引文别名。: The hypothesis is a program-rendered title from the pre-test execution card. Rationale and limitations come from actual model responses; only citation aliases were normalized.
strings.交接包记录了检验前锁定、六次模型评议、真实父反馈与内部/外部结果绑定。此界面展示: The handoff records the pre-test lock, six model reviews, actual parent feedback and bindings to internal/external results. This interface displays summary records; it does not claim that reviewers have rerun the analyses.
strings.完整原始提议、六次模型评议、预检验锁定、真实父反馈和外部行均保留来源绑定。此页是: Complete original proposals, six model reviews, the pre-test lock, actual parent feedback and external rows retain their source bindings. This page is a summary display, not a rerun of the experiments.
strings.P1、P2、P3涉及感觉运动、岛叶及视觉相关连接异常或降低；仅作双诊断ROI低方: P1, P2 and P3 concern abnormalities or reductions in somatomotor, insular and visual-related connectivity; they motivate only exploratory testing of a reduced ROI-level measure in two diagnoses.
strings.外部结果来自相邻或局部回路，未直接测量该ROI—网络边；不外推共同效应、特异性或: Results from other studies concern neighbouring or local circuits, not a direct measurement of this ROI–network connection; they do not establish a shared effect, specificity or causality.
strings.三位专家均认为证据异质性、P1无方向及固定范围限制充分；保留原卡，不把相邻回路线: All three expert-role agents considered the limitations on evidence heterogeneity, the absence of a direction in P1 and the fixed scope adequate. The original card was retained, without treating neighbouring-circuit clues or parent feedback as a direct ROI effect.
strings.承接[父假设]的双诊断低方向高稳定反馈，细化至新ROI 108。: Following stable feedback indicating reductions in both diagnoses for [parent hypothesis], the proposal was refined to the new ROI108.
strings.P1、P2与P3涉及岛叶、感觉运动或视觉相关连接异常，检验该ROI—SomMot: P1, P2 and P3 concern abnormal insular, somatomotor or visual-related connectivity, motivating a test of reduced connectivity for this ROI–SomMot connection.
strings.证据来自局部回路、不同诊断和指标，未直接验证该ROI聚合边或TCP共同效应；不作: The evidence comes from local circuits, different diagnoses and different metrics; it does not directly validate this aggregated ROI connection or a shared TCP effect. No specificity or causal inference is made.
strings.三方复审确认端点、范围及证据限制合规，保留原卡并维持探索性解读。: Review by all three roles found the endpoint, scope and evidence limitations compliant. The original card and exploratory interpretation were retained.
strings.承接[父假设]的SalVentAttn:Vis低方向反馈，细化至ROI 098—: Following feedback indicating reduced SalVentAttn:Vis connectivity for [parent hypothesis], the proposal was refined to ROI098–SomMot for further exploration.
strings.P1提示ADHD运动相关局部连接降低，P2提示精神病躯体感觉/枕叶区域连接减弱；: P1 suggests reduced motor-related local connectivity in ADHD, and P2 suggests reduced somatosensory/occipital regional connectivity in psychosis. Neither directly anchors the Limbic network; the negative direction is only a minimal-prior exploratory transfer.
strings.P1为局部、P2为区域正则化，均非Limbic-SomMot全边均值；缺乏Lim: P1 uses local connectivity and P2 regional regularization; neither measures the mean of all Limbic–SomMot edges. Direct Limbic evidence is absent; the source direction, TCP effect size, P value and calibrated CI require independent estimation.
strings.采纳三位评审关于Limbic缺少直接锚点及[已移除引文]作用未交代的意见，删除[: Following the three reviewers' comments on the lack of a direct Limbic anchor and the unexplained role of [removed citation], that citation was removed and transfer limitations were strengthened.
strings.依据父卡[父假设]，回应三位评审，删除未在理由中支撑的[已移除引文]，补明缺乏L: Based on the parent card [parent hypothesis] and the three reviews, [removed citation], which was unsupported in the rationale, was deleted. The lack of direct Limbic evidence was stated and cross-network transfer limitations were strengthened.
strings.P1来自社交恐惧共病样本，P2仅列视觉异常，P3/P4为广义背景；无DorsAt: P1 comes from a sample with social-phobia comorbidity, P2 only lists visual abnormalities, and P3/P4 provide broad background. There is no direct DorsAttn–Vis evidence or evidence of a shared direction; the direction is only an indirectly motivated code to be tested.
strings.局部、共病及广义网络结果不能外推DorsAttn-Vis全边均值；父项仅作排序，: Local, comorbidity and broad-network results cannot be extrapolated to the mean of all DorsAttn–Vis edges. The parent item only informs ranking. Multiple-round adaptive endpoint selection was not multiplicity-corrected, and no TCP effect size, P value or calibrated CI was available at proposal time.
strings.采纳三方终审：补明DorsAttn直接证据缺口、父项仅排序及自适应搜索未作多重校: The final reviews from all three roles were incorporated: the direct DorsAttn evidence gap, the ranking-only role of the parent item and the absence of multiplicity correction for adaptive search were made explicit.
strings.无新的TCP结果；针对评审关于自适应扩展与多重性的意见，明确父项仅供探索排序，将: No new TCP results were available. In response to comments on adaptive expansion and multiplicity, the parent item was explicitly limited to exploratory ranking, and this endpoint remained a code to be tested.
strings.P1、P3分别提示运动或精神病连接降低；P2限于双相II抑郁且含升、降连接，故-: P1 and P3 suggest reductions in motor-related connectivity or connectivity in psychosis, respectively. P2 is limited to bipolar II depression and contains both increased and decreased connections, so −1 is only a falsifiable exploratory direction for three diagnoses.
strings.P2含双向结果且限于双相II抑郁；所有证据均未直接测量ROI 314—SomMo: P2 contains effects in both directions and is limited to bipolar II depression. None of the evidence directly measures mean ROI314–SomMot connectivity; no shared effect, specificity or causality is inferred.
strings.回应方法学专家指出的P2方向选择偏倚：补明其双向结果及双相II抑郁范围，将低方向: In response to the methodology expert's concern about directional selection bias in P2, its bidirectional results and bipolar II depression scope were stated, and the reduced direction was limited to falsifiable exploration.
strings.承接[父假设]的三诊断SalVentAttn:SomMot高稳定低方向，细化至R: Following stable reductions in SalVentAttn:SomMot connectivity across three diagnoses for [parent hypothesis], the proposal was refined to ROI314.
strings.P1、P2提示控制或运动相关低连接，P3提示双相感觉运动网络异常；仅作双诊断RO: P1 and P2 suggest reduced control- or motor-related connectivity, while P3 suggests somatomotor network abnormalities in bipolar disorder. The proposal is only exploratory testing of a reduced ROI-level measure in two diagnoses.
strings.证据未直接测量该ROI—网络边，且回路与指标异质；不外推共同效应、特异性或因果关: The evidence does not directly measure this ROI–network connection, and circuits and metrics are heterogeneous. No shared effect, specificity or causality is inferred.
strings.三位专家均认为P3无方向已如实保留，其他材料仅支持部分低方向；保留原卡，父反馈不: All three expert-role agents agreed that the absence of a direction in P3 was accurately retained and that other materials supported reductions only in part. The original card was kept; parent feedback does not confirm a bipolar ROI effect.
strings.承接[父假设]的ADHD与双相低方向可排名反馈，细化至新ROI 104。: Following ranking-eligible feedback indicating reductions in ADHD and bipolar disorder for [parent hypothesis], the proposal was refined to the new ROI104.
strings.P1、P2涉及岛叶及视觉相关异常；P3限于双相II抑郁且岛叶—感觉运动连接一降一: P1 and P2 concern insular and visual-related abnormalities. P3 is limited to bipolar II depression and reports one decreased and one increased insular–somatomotor connection. This is therefore only a falsifiable exploratory test of a reduced ROI-level measure in two diagnoses.
strings.P3为双相II抑郁且方向双向，P1/P2来自局部或相邻回路；未直接验证ROI 2: P3 concerns bipolar II depression and has effects in both directions; P1/P2 concern local or neighbouring circuits. They do not directly validate the TCP mean for ROI254–SalVentAttn, provide no P value or calibrated CI for it, and establish no shared effect, specificity or causality.
strings.按三位专家意见，补明P3双向结果及双相II抑郁语境，避免选择性报告并收紧共同低方: Following the three experts' comments, P3's bidirectional results and bipolar II depression context were stated to avoid selective reporting and restrict cross-stage extrapolation of a shared reduction.
strings.承接[父假设]的双诊断低方向高稳定反馈，转检新ROI 254。: Following stable feedback indicating reductions in two diagnoses for [parent hypothesis], testing was shifted to the new ROI254.
strings.P1为早期广网、P2方向混合、P3无方向，未直接检验DorsAttn–SalVe: P1 concerns early-stage broad networks, P2 contains mixed directions and P3 specifies no direction. None directly tests DorsAttn–SalVentAttn; −1 is only a post-feedback code to be tested.
strings.文献未给该配对全边均值或共同方向；本端点无统一N、效应量、P值、校准CI，诊断缩: The literature supplies neither the mean of all edges for this pair nor a shared direction. At proposal time, no common N, effect size, P value or calibrated CI was available for this endpoint. Narrowing the diagnoses was an adaptive selection without multiplicity correction.
strings.采纳三方pass1：明确低向无直接证据，补端点映射、统计不确定性与反馈驱动多重性: Comments from all three pass1 reviews were incorporated: the lack of direct evidence for a reduction, endpoint mapping, statistical uncertainty and feedback-driven multiplicity limitations were made explicit.
strings.无新TCP结果；承接父项[父假设]低向反馈，保留双诊断但仅作反馈后探索；不将父项: No new TCP results were available. Following reduced-direction feedback for [parent hypothesis], two diagnoses were retained for post-feedback exploration only; the parent item's ranking was not described as literature support.
strings.P1支持双相与精神病网络内下降；P2仅为ADHD干预后重组，P3为双相模式且未定: P1 supports within-network reductions in bipolar disorder and psychosis. P2 concerns only post-intervention reorganization in ADHD, and P3 describes bipolar patterns without a direction. Thus, −1 across three diagnoses is only a low-prior exploratory direction.
strings.P1为动态网络内结果，P2为干预重组且不提供ADHD基线方向，P3未定向；不等同: P1 reports dynamic within-network results; P2 concerns intervention-related reorganization and provides no baseline ADHD direction; P3 is nondirectional. These are not equivalent to the mean of all SalVentAttn edges. The TCP effect size, P value and calibrated CI remained to be estimated at proposal time.
strings.按临床与方法学复核，明确P2仅为干预重组且不提供ADHD基线方向；父卡稳定性不外: Following clinical and methodological review, it was clarified that P2 concerns intervention-related reorganization only and provides no baseline ADHD direction. Stability of the parent card was not extrapolated.
strings.回应评审，父卡SalVentAttn稳定性仅作选题线索，明确P2不支持ADHD基: In response to the reviews, parent-card SalVentAttn stability was used only as a topic-selection clue, and it was clarified that P2 does not support reduced baseline connectivity in ADHD. The falsifiable −1 direction for three diagnoses was retained for exploration.
strings.P1支持双相与精神病视觉网络内下降，P2给出精神病视觉相关连接降低，P3提示双相: P1 supports within-visual-network reductions in bipolar disorder and psychosis, P2 reports reduced visual-related connectivity in psychosis, and P3 suggests abnormal amygdala–visual network connectivity in bipolar disorder. These motivate testing a negative Limbic–Vis direction.
strings.P1为动态网络内、P2为任务局部、P3未定向；均不等同Limbic-Vis全边均: P1 reports dynamic within-network results, P2 task-related local results, and P3 no direction. None is equivalent to the mean of all Limbic–Vis edges; the TCP effect size, P value and calibrated CI remained to be estimated at proposal time.
strings.六份审阅均认可端点与证据边界；保留原卡，不把来源视觉连接直接解释为TCP均值效应: All six reviews accepted the endpoint and evidence boundaries. The original card was retained, without directly interpreting visual-connectivity findings from the sources as an effect on the TCP mean.
strings.依据父卡[父假设]的Vis内三诊断高方向稳定，改测Limbic-Vis并聚焦双相: Following high directional stability within Vis across three diagnoses in the parent card [parent hypothesis], testing shifted to Limbic–Vis and focused on bipolar disorder and psychosis to examine cross-network transfer.
strings.儿童 ADHD 的 NIRS 局部连接，不是本次静息 fMRI 跨网均值；模态和: Local NIRS connectivity in children with ADHD, not the current resting-state fMRI cross-network mean; both modality and population differ.
strings.既有 BD-I 感觉运动连接/执行功能线索。所存原句是机制不清楚的背景，不是该精: Prior BD-I clues concern somatomotor connectivity/executive function. The stored sentence is background about unclear mechanisms, not a direct finding of a reduction in this exact ROI; direction requires checking the original text.
strings.既有 SZ/MDD/BD 跨诊断研究，说明跨诊断概念本身并非新提出。不能直接支持: Prior transdiagnostic SZ/MDD/BD research shows that the transdiagnostic concept itself is not new. It does not directly support the direction of the exact parcel-to-whole-network mean.
strings.既有双相岛叶—中央后回连接降低，也包含其他连接升高；人群、侧别、疾病阶段和测量不: Prior bipolar findings include reduced insula–postcentral gyrus connectivity and increases in other connections. Population, laterality, disease stage and measurement differ; only the favourable direction must not be retained.
strings.视觉言语启动任务中的局部连接结果；任务与本次静息全网络均值不同。: Local-connectivity findings during a visual verbal-priming task; the task differs from the current resting-state whole-network mean.
strings.这是历史记录，不代表本版已核实其与精确候选的直接匹配；请结合原文判断。: This is a historical record, not confirmation that this version has verified a direct match to the exact candidate. Consult the original text when judging it.
strings.SZ 正则化区域/体素连接，缺少本候选 Limbic 直接锚点；不是完整全文核查: Regularized regional/voxel connectivity in SZ, without a direct Limbic anchor for this candidate; this is not a complete full-text check.
strings.历史 KG 记录；未在本版独立核验原文，年份保留原记录。: Historical KG record; the original text has not been independently verified in this version, and the recorded year is retained.
strings.三份完整材料试用；尚未冻结正式抽样、伦理与招募安排。不是正式人类评价结果。: A three-material complete-output pilot. Formal sampling, ethics and recruitment arrangements have not been frozen. These are not formal human-evaluation results.
strings.既往证据是否为提出这项假设提供了合理依据？: Does prior evidence provide a reasonable basis for proposing this hypothesis?
strings.评价提出假设的依据，不要求前人已经证实同一个假设。: Judge the basis for proposing the hypothesis; prior work need not have confirmed the same hypothesis.
strings.主要依据不相关或被误读: The main evidence is irrelevant or misinterpreted
strings.部分有依据，但关键推断缺乏解释: Partly grounded, but key inferences are unexplained
strings.有清晰依据，并说明了证据迁移的限制: Clearly grounded, with limits on evidence transfer explained
strings.相对于已有研究，这项假设具有多大的实质新颖性？: How substantively novel is this hypothesis relative to prior research?
strings.基于给定文献及本人知识判断；不是全球首次性认证。现有文献来自历史 KG 记录，尚: Judge using the supplied literature and your own knowledge; this does not certify a global first. The literature comes from historical KG records and lacks a systematic novelty search.
strings.1 · 基本重复：相同问题和关系已有直接报道: 1 · Essentially repeated: the same question and relation have been directly reported
strings.2 · 很小：主要是标签、相邻分区或技术细节变化: 2 · Very small: mainly changes to labels, neighbouring parcels or technical details
strings.3 · 有限但实质：扩展至新的诊断组合、人群或测量定义: 3 · Limited but substantive: extends to a new diagnostic combination, population or measurement definition
strings.4 · 明确：提出前人证据未直接覆盖的重要关系或适用边界: 4 · Clear: proposes an important relation or applicability boundary not directly covered by prior evidence
strings.5 · 很强：提出明显不同、可能改变既有理解的科学命题: 5 · Very strong: proposes a clearly distinct scientific proposition that could change existing understanding
strings.所列数据和分析能否检验核心假设？: Can the listed data and analyses test the central hypothesis?
strings.只能检验部分组成或较弱的命题: Can only test some components or a weaker proposition
strings.能够检验所述关联及明确限定的范围: Can test the stated association within the explicitly defined scope
strings.实际分析是否形成可供科学解释的结果？: Did the actual analysis produce scientifically interpretable results?
strings.分析有效不等于假设获得支持；探索性分析不自动无效。: A valid analysis does not mean the hypothesis is supported; exploratory analyses are not automatically invalid.
strings.没有形成有效分析结果: No valid analysis results were produced
strings.形成结果，但存在影响解释的关键方法问题: Results were produced, but key methodological issues affect interpretation
strings.形成结果，未发现使其不可解释的关键缺陷: Results were produced, with no identified critical flaw making them uninterpretable
strings.核心假设目前得到怎样的经验结果？: What empirical outcome is currently obtained for the central hypothesis?
strings.效应方向一致不一定足够；没有通过标准不等于被证伪。: Agreement in effect direction may be insufficient; failing a criterion is not equivalent to falsification.
strings.证据不确定或只支持部分组成: Uncertain evidence or support for only some components
strings.在所述探索性范围内获得支持: Supported within the stated exploratory scope
strings.无有效分析结果，不作科学支持判断: No valid analysis results; no judgment of scientific support
strings.这些结果对核心跨诊断关联提供了多充分的支持？: How adequately do these results support the central transdiagnostic association?
strings.结合效应、不确定性、混杂与验证覆盖，不只看方向或是否越过筛选门槛。: Consider effects, uncertainty, confounders and validation coverage, not only direction or crossing a screening threshold.
strings.1 · 很弱：核心关系缺乏支持或结果相互冲突: 1 · Very weak: the central relation lacks support or results conflict
strings.2 · 较弱：只有部分组成或很不稳定的证据: 2 · Weak: evidence covers only some components or is very unstable
strings.3 · 中等：有实质支持，但不确定性或覆盖限制明显: 3 · Moderate: substantive support, but clear uncertainty or coverage limitations
strings.4 · 较充分：主要组成与相关敏感性结果提供一致支持: 4 · Adequate: main components and relevant sensitivity results provide consistent support
strings.5 · 很充分：在所述范围内证据充分，主要替代解释得到妥善处理: 5 · Very adequate: sufficient evidence within scope, with the main alternative explanations properly addressed
strings.该研究结果增加了多少有意义的科学信息？: How much meaningful scientific information does this research result add?
strings.准确的不支持结果也可能有价值。新颖性与科学意义分开评价，不以显著性代替价值。: Accurate non-supportive results may also be valuable. Judge novelty separately from scientific importance; significance is not a substitute for value.
strings.1 · 很少：没有可辨认的可信信息增量: 1 · Very little: no discernible gain in credible information
strings.2 · 较少：主要重复已有认识，增量有限: 2 · Little: mainly repeats existing understanding, with limited additions
strings.3 · 中等：提供有价值的验证、扩展或适用边界: 3 · Moderate: offers valuable validation, an extension or an applicability boundary
strings.4 · 明确：对具体科学问题提供重要的新信息: 4 · Clear: provides important new information on a specific scientific question
strings.5 · 很大：对该问题的理解构成实质推进，并值得深入研究: 5 · Large: substantially advances understanding of the question and warrants further study
strings.综合来看，这项结果主要属于哪类科研产出？: Overall, what type of scientific output best describes this result?
strings.这是产出类型判断，不是分数排序；“有证据的新关联”不等于首次性、因果机制或临床用: This classifies output type, not score rank. An evidence-supported new association does not confirm first discovery, a causal mechanism or clinical utility.
strings.对已知关系的有价值复核: A valuable re-examination of a known relation
strings.对已知关系的新范围、测量或适用边界的扩展: An extension of a known relation to a new scope, measurement or applicability boundary
strings.具有实质新颖性、并获得当前证据支持的观察性关联: A substantively novel observational association supported by current evidence
strings.值得继续研究，但尚未得到充分支持的候选假设: A candidate hypothesis worth pursuing but not yet adequately supported
strings.有信息价值的不支持或反向结果: An informative non-supportive or opposite-direction result
strings.目前没有可解释的科学产出: No interpretable scientific output at present
strings.材料中的整理者摘要是否与结果及其适用范围一致？: Is the curator summary consistent with the results and their scope of applicability?
strings.本批没有外部分析后的模型总结原文。本题评价明确标注的整理者摘要，不评价系统独立撰: This batch has no original model summary after external analysis. This question evaluates the explicitly labelled curator summary, not the system's ability to independently write conclusions.
strings.核心说明缺乏支持或与结果矛盾: The central description lacks support or contradicts the results
strings.主要有依据，但需实质性收窄: Mostly grounded, but requires substantial narrowing
strings.范围恰当，无需实质性修改: Appropriately scoped, without a need for substantive revision
strings.展示的结论能否追溯到测量定义、分析和结果？: Can the displayed conclusions be traced to measurement definitions, analyses and results?
strings.审阅汇总记录不等于已经重新运行分析。: Reviewing summary records does not mean the analyses have been rerun.
strings.外部分析覆盖并支持了哪些具名诊断组成？: Which named diagnostic components are covered and supported by external analyses?
strings.COBRE/HCP-EP 的精神病结果不能替代 ADHD 或双相验证。: Psychosis results from COBRE/HCP-EP cannot substitute for ADHD or bipolar validation.
strings.尚不能支持完整具名诊断组合: The complete named diagnostic combination is not yet supported
strings.部分组成有支持，整体仍有明显不确定性: Some components are supported, but substantial overall uncertainty remains
strings.在所述探索性范围内支持全部具名诊断组成: All named diagnostic components are supported within the stated exploratory scope
strings.展示的后轮提议是否合理利用了此前的真实实验反馈？: Does the displayed later-round proposal make reasonable use of actual earlier experimental feedback?
strings.评价已记录的反馈到新提议关系，不证明反馈带来了性能提升。: Evaluate the recorded link from feedback to the new proposal; this does not establish that feedback improved performance.
strings.与反馈脱节或推论不合理: Disconnected from feedback or based on unreasonable inference
strings.部分利用，但推断依据有限: Uses feedback in part, but with a limited inferential basis
strings.合理利用结果并保留推断限制: Uses results reasonably while retaining limits on inference
strings.检验 ADHD、双相及 SZ/SZA 中具名诊断组合，是否在固定连接测量上分别相: Test whether named diagnostic combinations among ADHD, bipolar disorder and SZ/SZA each show same-direction changes relative to controls on a fixed connectivity measure. Hypotheses were locked before measuring that TCP candidate, but used earlier TCP feedback from the same seed during formulation. Stage A uniformly hides parent-feedback values and current candidate results; those records are provided in stage B. This stage therefore does not reproduce the complete original generation context.
strings.给出的文献是当时知识图谱的已有记录及整理者限制说明，尚未完成逐项最接近文献/全文: The literature comprises records from the knowledge graph at the time, with curator limitation notes. Candidate-by-candidate checks of the closest prior work and full-text novelty remain incomplete. Some sentences concern background or other modalities. You may choose Insufficient material; absence of a known report need not be equated with a first discovery. No answer is preselected.
strings.本试用版取自已完成发现臂及其两阶段外部分析，未包含在途扩充。来源共有 104 个: This pilot comes from the completed discovery arm and its two-stage external analyses, excluding ongoing expansions. The source contains 104 distinct tested hypotheses and 50 metrics; 38 hypotheses/25 metrics completed external analysis. Eight eligible diagnostic variants lack complete external analysis, and the remaining 58 hypotheses did not enter external analysis. These three examples were selected for material piloting, not to represent the natural success rate.
strings.外部分析后没有新增模型总结回答。下面的自然语言摘要由材料整理者撰写；原始程序只提: No new model summary was produced after external analysis. The natural-language summary below was written by the material curator; the original program provides only structured decisions. Summary ratings cannot be interpreted as the system's ability to independently write conclusions. Internal model-review roles are also not the human experts in this study.
strings.该固定 ROI—网络测量在 UCLA 的双相和 SCHZ 比较中均呈降低，并在: This fixed ROI–network measure is reduced in both UCLA bipolar and SCHZ comparisons, with same-direction effects in psychosis components or extensions in COBRE/HCP-EP. It is a candidate transdiagnostic association with exploratory external support. This does not establish bipolar validation in all three cohorts, causality, specificity or clinical diagnostic value.
strings.该 ROI—网络测量有探索性外部支持，但 UCLA 跨诊断联合方向频率接近既定门: This ROI–network measure has exploratory external support, but the UCLA transdiagnostic joint direction frequency is close to the predefined threshold. Psychosis components agree in direction in the other two cohorts. These results are insufficient to claim the first discovery of abnormal insular–somatomotor connectivity or establish causality.
strings.精神病组成得到外部同向结果，但 UCLA 的 ADHD 效应较小，跨诊断联合稳定: Psychosis components have same-direction external results, but the UCLA ADHD effect is small and transdiagnostic joint stability is limited. Current evidence is insufficient for a strong shared ADHD–psychosis phenotype. Psychosis-cohort results cannot replace ADHD validation, and lack of support cannot be called significant falsification.
strings.依据父卡[父假设]，回应三位评审，删除未在理由中支撑的E019，补明缺乏Limb: Based on the parent card [parent hypothesis] and the three reviews, E019, which was unsupported in the rationale, was removed. The absence of direct Limbic evidence was stated and cross-network transfer limitations were strengthened.
strings.左侧 ROI108 分区与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在双相: Functional connectivity between the left ROI108 parcel and the sensorimotor network (SomMot) is expected to be lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
strings.左侧 ROI098 分区与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在双相: Functional connectivity between the left ROI098 parcel and the sensorimotor network (SomMot) is expected to be lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
strings.边缘网络（Limbic）与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在 A: Functional connectivity between the limbic network (Limbic) and the sensorimotor network (SomMot) is expected to be lower in both ADHD and schizophrenia/schizoaffective patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
strings.背侧注意网络（DorsAttn）与视觉网络（Vis）之间的功能连接强度，在 AD: Functional connectivity between the dorsal attention network (DorsAttn) and the visual network (Vis) is expected to be lower in all three patient groups — ADHD, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder — than in their respective control groups, with the decrease in the same direction.
strings.右侧 ROI314 分区与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在 A: Functional connectivity between the right ROI314 parcel and the sensorimotor network (SomMot) is expected to be lower in all three patient groups — ADHD, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder — than in their respective control groups, with the decrease in the same direction.
strings.左侧 ROI104 分区与躯体运动网络（SomMot）之间的功能连接强度，在 A: Functional connectivity between the left ROI104 parcel and the sensorimotor network (SomMot) is expected to be lower in both ADHD and bipolar disorder patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
strings.右侧 ROI254 分区与显著性/腹侧注意网络（SalVentAttn）之间的功: Functional connectivity between the right ROI254 parcel and the salience/ventral attention network (SalVentAttn) is expected to be lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
strings.背侧注意网络（DorsAttn）与显著性/腹侧注意网络（SalVentAttn）: Functional connectivity between the dorsal attention network (DorsAttn) and the salience/ventral attention network (SalVentAttn) is expected to be lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
strings.显著性/腹侧注意网络（SalVentAttn）内部各分区之间的功能连接强度，在: Functional connectivity among parcels within the salience/ventral attention network (SalVentAttn) is expected to be lower in all three patient groups — ADHD, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder — than in their respective control groups, with the decrease in the same direction.
strings.边缘网络（Limbic）与视觉网络（Vis）之间的功能连接强度，在双相障碍患者和: Functional connectivity between the limbic network (Limbic) and the visual network (Vis) is expected to be lower in both bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective patients than in their respective control groups — a decrease in the same direction in both groups.
